evidence.finding: Canonical callable is server-owned/idempotent but OPERATIONS excludes apply_payment and confirm_application is explicitly rejected.
Browser client exposes preview/confirm proposal/HOLD, not canonical applyPayment.
Cobros still treats client report as por validar and contains direct store payment mutation paths.
Cliente360 keeps reported-payment validation state and legacy invoice semantics.
Portal reports payment by direct store update and creates validation work instead of using canonical payment owner.
Receipt payment UI does not yet expose V2-separated paidDate/support vs applicationDate/invoice fields.
Receipt detail projection does not yet surface all V2 reconciliation fields.

requiredFix: Add one server-owned idempotent apply_payment operation keyed to a canonical expected receipt.
Atomically materialize/update one cobro, close the matching expected receipt and portfolio obligation, and append reconciliation audit/request evidence.
Client-reported payment with unique valid receipt is payment evidence and does not require a second human approval; insurer application may remain pending.
Keep paidDate/support separate from applicationDate/invoiceNumber/invoice evidence.
Cliente360, Cobros and Portal must call the same payment command; remove/disable direct business-write alternatives.
Later invoice/application evidence enriches the same payment rather than creating another cobro.
